# After-Hours Telephone Call Log
Brightwater Commons | Security desk | 06/18/2026

## Desk reference
- Switchboard hours: Monday–Friday, 8:00 AM–5:00 PM; calls route to the security desk after closing.
- On-call facilities contact: Sunita Hendricks, 555-014-8826.
- Security officer on duty: Nadia Ibrahim, post 2.

## Call entries
- 6:42 PM — Raymond Nguyen called from the west loading area, 41 Harbor Street, to report water flowing from the ceiling near electrical panel W-3. He said the flow was increasing and no one was injured. Nadia recorded the location and caller details and advised that facilities would review the report in the morning. No alarms were sounding, and the caller remained outside the affected area.
- 7:15 PM — A delivery driver called to ask whether the north service gate would be open at 7:30 AM. Nadia confirmed that the gate is scheduled to open at 7:30 AM and provided the visitor check-in instructions: use the call box and show a photo ID at the security desk.

## Call handling summary
- The switchboard is open until 10:00 PM on weekdays.
- Nadia entered both calls in the desk log and passed the loading-area report to the incoming officer at shift change, 11:00 PM.
- No other calls requiring dispatch or emergency services were received during the shift.

## Follow-up
- Sunita Hendricks is listed as the facilities contact for non-emergency building issues.
- The north service gate schedule remains 7:30 AM; no schedule change was requested.

errors.quote: advised that facilities would review the report in the morning
errors.explanation: The caller reported increasing water flow near an electrical panel, creating an immediate hazard. The entry omits contacting the listed on-call facilities contact promptly and keeping people clear of the affected area; deferring review until morning is not an adequate response.
errors.fix: called Sunita Hendricks immediately and kept people clear of the affected area

errors.quote: The switchboard is open until 10:00 PM on weekdays.
errors.explanation: The desk reference states that the switchboard operates only until 5:00 PM on weekdays and calls route to security after closing. The 10:00 PM closing time contradicts that information.
errors.fix: The switchboard is open until 5:00 PM on weekdays.
